stem: 设 $ D: |x| \leqslant 1, 0 \leqslant y \leqslant 2 $，计算 $ I = \iint_{D} |y - x^{2}| \, dx \, dy $.
explanation:
由 $ y = x^{2} $ 将 $ D $ 划分为 $ D_{1} $ 与 $ D_{2} $，则 
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D}\left|y-x^{2}\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D_{1}}(y-x^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}(x^{2}-y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{-1}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{x^{2}}^{2}(y-x^{2})\mathrm{d}y+\int_{-1}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{x^{2}}(x^{2}-y)\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{-1}^{1}\left.\frac{1}{2}(y-x^{2})^{2}\right|_{x^{2}}^{2}\mathrm{d}x-\int_{-1}^{1}\left.\frac{1}{2}(y-x^{2})^{2}\right|_{x^{2}}^{x^{2}}\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}(4-4x^{2}+x^{4})\mathrm{d}x+\frac{1}{2}\int_{-1}^{1}x^{4}\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\int_{0}^{1}(2-2x^{2}+x^{4})\mathrm{d}x=2\times\left(2-\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{5}\right)=\frac{46}{15}.\end{aligned} 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 二重积分 / 计算 / 被积函数为分段函数 / 隐式分段 / 绝对值

stem: 设区域 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant\pi,0\leqslant y\leqslant\pi\right\} $，计算积分 $ \iint_{D}\left|\cos(x+y)\right|dxdy $。
explanation:
方法1：用直线 $ y=\frac{\pi}{2}-x $ 和 $ y=\frac{3}{2}\pi-x $ 将 $ D $ 分割为 $ D_{1},D_{2},D_{3} $，则
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint\limits_{D}\left|\cos(x+y)\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\iint\limits_{D_{1}}\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y-\iint\limits_{D_{2}}\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint\limits_{D_{3}}\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}-x}\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}y-\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}-x}^{\pi} \cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}y-\\&\quad\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\frac{3\pi}{2}-x}\cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}y+\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\frac{3\pi}{2}-x}^{\pi} \cos(x+y)\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1-\sin x)\mathrm{d}x+\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}(1+\sin x)\mathrm{d}x+\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}(1+\sin x)\mathrm{d}x+\\&\quad\int_{\frac{\pi}{2}}^{\pi}(1-\sin x)\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$
方法2：
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\left|\cos(x+y)\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y&=\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\pi}\left|\cos(x+y)\right|\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\pi}\left|\cos y\right|\mathrm{d}y=2\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 二重积分 / 计算 / 被积函数为分段函数 / 隐式分段 / 绝对值

stem: 设 $ D:0 \leqslant x \leqslant y \leqslant 2\pi $，则 $ I = \iint_{D} |\sin(x - y) | \, dx \, dy = $ ___。
explanation:
积分区域 $ D $ 如图所示。为去掉绝对值符号，由 $ y = x + \pi $ 将 $ D $ 划分为 $ D_{1} $ 与 $ D_{2} $，其中 $ D_{1}: -\pi\leqslant x-y\leqslant0 $，$ D_{2}: -2\pi\leqslant x-y\leqslant-\pi $。
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint_{D}\mid\sin(x-y)\mid\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\iint_{D_{1}}[-\sin(x-y)]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D_{2}}\sin(x-y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\int_{0}^{\pi}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{y}[-\sin(x-y)]\mathrm{d}x+\int_{\pi}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}y\int_{y-\pi}^{y}[-\sin(x-y)]\mathrm{d}x+\int_{\pi}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}y\int_{0}^{y-\pi}\sin(x-y)\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 二重积分 / 计算 / 被积函数为分段函数 / 隐式分段 / 绝对值

stem: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant4\right\} $，计算 $ I=\iint_{D}\left|2x-x^{2}-y^{2}\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y $。
explanation:
记 $ f(x,y)=2x-x^{2}-y^{2}=1-(x-1)^{2}-y^{2} $。由 $ (x-1)^{2}+y^{2}=1 $ 将 $ D $ 分成 $ D_{1} $ 与 $ D_{2} $ 两部分，其中 $ D_{1}=\left\{(x,y)\mid(x-1)^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant1\right\} $，$ D_{2}=D-D_{1} $。
$$
 \begin{aligned}I&=\iint\limits_{D}\mid f(x,y)\mid\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\iint\limits_{D_{1}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y-\iint\limits_{D_{2}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&=2\iint\limits_{D_{1}}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y-\iint\limits_{D}f(x,y)\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&\xlongequal{ 记 }I_{1}-I_{2},\end{aligned} 
$$
其中
$$
 \begin{aligned}I_{1}&=2\iint_{D_{1}}[1-(x-1)^{2}-y^{2}]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\&\xlongequal{x-1=r\cos\theta,\,y=r\sin\theta}2\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{1}(1-r^{2})r\mathrm{d}r\\&=4\pi\int_{0}^{1}(r-r^{3})\mathrm{d}r=\pi.\\I_{2}&=\iint_{D}[1-(x-1)^{2}-y^{2}]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=\iint_{D}(2x-x^{2}-y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y.\end{aligned} 
$$
由于 $ D $ 关于 $ y $ 轴对称，$ 2x $ 是奇函数，故 $ \iint_{D}2x\,dx\,dy = 0 $。所以，
$$
 I_{2}=0-\iint_{D}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y=-\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2}r^{2}\bullet r\mathrm{d}r=-8\pi, 
$$
于是 $ I = I_{1} - I_{2} = \pi - (-8\pi) = 9\pi. $
category_path: 高等数学 / 二重积分 / 计算 / 被积函数为分段函数 / 隐式分段 / 绝对值

stem: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}|x-|y||d\sigma $，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)|x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant2x,x\leqslant1\right\} $。
explanation:
积分区域 $ D $ 关于 $ x $ 轴对称，记 $ D_{1} $ 为 $ D $ 在 $ x $ 轴上方的部分。用直线 $ y = x $ 将 $ D_{1} $ 分割为 $ D_{11} $ 与 $ D_{12} $ 两部分，如图所示。则
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}\left|x-|y|\right| d\sigma &=2\iint_{D_{1}}\left|x-y\right|d\sigma\\&=2\iint_{D_{11}}(x-y)d\sigma-2\iint_{D_{12}}(x-y)d\sigma\\&=2\int_{0}^{1}d x\int_{0}^{x}(x-y)d y-2\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\theta\int_{0}^{2\cos\theta}r^{2}(\cos\theta-\sin\theta)d r\\&=\int_{0}^{1}x^{2}d x-\frac{16}{3}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{3}\theta(\cos\theta-\sin\theta)d\theta\\&=\frac{1}{3}-\frac{4}{3}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(\frac{3}{2}+2\cos2\theta+\frac{1}{2}\cos4\theta\right)d\theta-\frac{16}{3}\int_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\cos^{3}\theta d(\cos\theta)\\&=\frac{1}{3}-\frac{4}{3}\left(\frac{3}{2}\theta+\sin2\theta+\frac{1}{8}\sin4\theta\right)\bigg|_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}-\frac{4}{3}\left(\cos^{4}\theta\right)\bigg|_{\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\\&=\frac{1}{3}-\frac{4}{3}\left(\frac{3\pi}{8}-1\right)+\frac{1}{3}=2-\frac{\pi}{2}.\end{aligned} 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 二重积分 / 计算 / 被积函数为分段函数 / 隐式分段 / 绝对值

stem: 计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}\left|x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y $，其中 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid x^{2}+y^{2}\leqslant4\right\} $。
explanation:
用曲线 $ \left(x-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^{2}+\left(y-\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^{2}=1 $ 将 $D$ 划分为 $D_{1},D_{2}$ 两部分，如图所示，则有
$$
 \begin{aligned}&\iint_{D}\left|x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right|\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&-\iint_{\overline{D}_{1}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{\overline{D}_{2}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&-\iint_{\overline{D}_{1}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{D-D_{1}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&-2\iint_{\overline{D}_{1}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y+\iint_{\overline{D}}\left[x^{2}+y^{2}-\sqrt{2}(x+y)\right]\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&-4\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)}\left[r^{3}-\sqrt{2}r^{2}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)\right]\mathrm{d}r+\iint_{\overline{D}}(x^{2}+y^{2})\mathrm{d}x\mathrm{d}y\\=&\frac{4}{3}\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(\cos\theta+\sin\theta)^{4}\mathrm{d}\theta+\int_{0}^{2\pi}\mathrm{d}\theta\int_{0}^{2}r^{3}\mathrm{d}r=\frac{16}{3}\int_{-\frac{\pi}{4}}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{4}\left(\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}\right)\mathrm{d}\theta+8\pi\\&\xlongequal{\theta+\frac{\pi}{4}=t}\frac{16}{3}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^{4}t\mathrm{d}t+8\pi=\frac{16}{3}\cdot\frac{3}{4}\cdot\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}+8\pi=9\pi.\end{aligned} 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 二重积分 / 计算 / 被积函数为分段函数 / 隐式分段 / 绝对值

stem: 设 $ D=\{(x,y)|0\leqslant x\leqslant2,0\leqslant y\leqslant2\} $，计算 $ \iint_{D}|xy-1|\,\mathrm{d}\sigma $。
explanation:
作出区域 $D$ 如图所示。在 $D$ 中作曲线 $ y=\frac{1}{x} $ 及直线 $ x=\frac{1}{2} $，将 $D$ 分成 3 块 $ D_{1},D_{2} $ 及 $ D_{3} $（见图）。
$$
 \mid xy-1\mid=\left\{\begin{aligned}&1-xy,&(x,y)\in D_{1},\\ &1-xy,&(x,y)\in D_{2},\\ &xy-1,&(x,y)\in D_{3}.\end{aligned}\right. 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint\limits_{D}\mid xy-1\mid\mathrm{d}\sigma=&\iint\limits_{D_{1}}(1-xy)\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint\limits_{D_{2}}(1-xy)\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint\limits_{D_{3}}(xy-1)\mathrm{d}\sigma\\=&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{2}(1-xy)\mathrm{d}y+\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{x}}(1-xy)\mathrm{d}y+\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{2}\mathrm{d}x\int_{\frac{1}{x}}^{2}(xy-1)\mathrm{d}y\\=&\int_{0}^{\frac{1}{2}}(2-2x)\mathrm{d}x+\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{2}\frac{1}{2x}\mathrm{d}x+\int_{\frac{1}{2}}^{2}\left(2x-2+\frac{1}{2x}\right)\mathrm{d}x=\frac{3}{2}+2\ln2.\end{aligned} 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 二重积分 / 计算 / 被积函数为分段函数 / 隐式分段 / 绝对值

stem: 设 $ D=\left\{(x,y)\mid0\leqslant x\leqslant1,0\leqslant y\leqslant2\mathrm{e}\right\} $，计算二重积分 $ \iint_{D}x\left|y-\mathrm{e}^{x}\right|\mathrm{d}\sigma $。
explanation:
如图所示，将 $D$ 分成 $ D_{1} \cup D_{2} $，$ D_{1} $ 与 $ D_{2} $ 除边界之外无公共部分。
$$
 \begin{aligned}\iint_{D}x\mid y-\mathrm{e}^{x}\mid\mathrm{d}\sigma=&\iint_{D_{1}}x\mid y-\mathrm{e}^{x}\mid\mathrm{d}\sigma+\iint_{D_{2}}x\mid y-\mathrm{e}^{x}\mid\mathrm{d}\sigma\\=&\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{e^{x}}^{2e}x(y-\mathrm{e}^{x})\mathrm{d}y+\int_{0}^{1}\mathrm{d}x\int_{0}^{e^{x}}x(\mathrm{e}^{x}-y)\mathrm{d}y\\=&\int_{0}^{1}\left(\frac{xy^{2}}{2}-yx\mathrm{e}^{x}\right)\left|\frac{2e}{e^{x}}\mathrm{d}x+\int_{0}^{1}\left(yx\mathrm{e}^{x}-\frac{xy^{2}}{2}\right)\right|_{0}^{e^{x}}\mathrm{d}x\\=&\int_{0}^{1}\left(2\mathrm{e}^{x}x-2\mathrm{e}x\mathrm{e}^{x}+\frac{1}{2}x\mathrm{e}^{2x}\right)\mathrm{d}x+\int_{0}^{1}\frac{x}{2}\mathrm{e}^{2x}\mathrm{d}x\\=&\frac{5}{4}\mathrm{e}^{2}-2\mathrm{e}+\frac{1}{4}.\end{aligned} 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 二重积分 / 计算 / 被积函数为分段函数 / 隐式分段 / 绝对值

stem:
计算二重积分
$$
I=\iint_D|x^2+y^2-1|\,\mathrm{d}\sigma,
$$
其中
$$
D=\{(x,y)\mid0\le x\le1,\ 0\le y\le1\}.
$$
explanation:
记
$$
D_1=\{(x,y)\in D\mid x^2+y^2\le1\}.
$$
先计算不带绝对值的积分：
$$
\iint_D(x^2+y^2-1)\,\mathrm{d}\sigma
=\frac13+\frac13-1=-\frac13.
$$
在四分之一单位圆盘 $D_1$ 上使用极坐标：
$$
\begin{aligned}
\iint_{D_1}(x^2+y^2-1)\,\mathrm{d}\sigma
&=\int_0^{\pi/2}\int_0^1(r^2-1)r\,\mathrm{d}r\,\mathrm{d}\theta\\
&=-\frac\pi8.
\end{aligned}
$$
绝对值使 $D_1$ 上的符号反转，所以
$$
I=-\frac13-2\left(-\frac\pi8\right)=\frac\pi4-\frac13.
$$

stem: 设变换 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x-2y,\\ v&=x+ay\end{aligned}\right. $ 可把方程 $ 6\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ 简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $ ，求常数 $ a $ 。（这里应假设 $ z $ 有二阶连续偏导数）
explanation:
由变换 $ u = x - 2y $, $ v = x + ay $，计算一阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial z}{\partial u} + \frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, \quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -2\frac{\partial z}{\partial u} + a\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}. 
$$
计算二阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} + 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = -2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} + (a-2)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} = 4\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}} - 4a\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}. 
$$
代入原方程 $ 6\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $，整理得：
$$
 (10+5a)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} + (6+a-a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}} = 0. 
$$
为使方程简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v} = 0 $，需满足：
$$
 \begin{cases}10+5a \neq 0, \\ 6+a-a^{2} = 0.\end{cases} 
$$
由 $ 6+a-a^{2} = 0 $ 得 $ (3-a)(2+a) = 0 $，解得 $ a = 3 $ 或 $ a = -2 $。由 $ 10+5a \neq 0 $ 得 $ a \neq -2 $，且若 $ a = -2 $ 则 $ u = v $，变换无意义。因此取 $ a = 3 $。
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 利用变量代换化简偏微分方程 / 线性变换

stem: 设函数 $ z(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，则下列各项中的变换能将方程 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ 化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $ 的是（）
explanation:
观察选项知，可设 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}u&=x+by,\\ v&=cx+y.\end{aligned}\right. $ 将 u, v 看作中间变量，分别计算 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}, \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}, \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} $。计算得： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}+c\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=b\frac{\partial z}{\partial u}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial v}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+2c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+c^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+c\frac{\partial z^{2}}{\partial v^{2}}\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}=b\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+\left(1+b c\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+c\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}\;=\;b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\;\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\;+\;b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\;\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v\partial u}\;\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}\;\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\;=\;b^{2}\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}\;+\;2b\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}\;+\;\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}. 
$$
 代入原方程 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}-3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $，可得 
$$
 \left(2+b-3b^{2}\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u^{2}}+\left(4c+1+b c-6b\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}+\left(2c^{2}+c-3\right)\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial v^{2}}=0. 
$$
 由已知条件，该方程可化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u\partial v}=0 $，故 
$$
 \begin{cases}2+b-3b^{2}=0,\\4c+1+bc-6b\neq0,\\2c^{2}+c-3=0.\end{cases} 
$$
 解得 b = 1 或 $ -\frac{2}{3} $，c = 1 或 $ -\frac{3}{2} $。由此可排除选项 A、C、D。并且，选项 B 满足 $ b = -\frac{2}{3} $，c = 1，且符合 $ 4c + 1 + bc - 6b \neq 0 $ 的要求。因此，应选 B.
source: 900 第四章数二 B 类
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 利用变量代换化简偏微分方程 / 线性变换

stem: 设 $ z = z(x, y) $ 二阶偏导数连续，且 $ \begin{cases} u = x + ay, \\ v = x + by \end{cases} $（$a \lt b$）可将方程 $ 3\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} - 4\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} + \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $ 化简为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial u \partial v} = 0, z(x, 0) = \sin x, z_{y}^{\prime}(x, 0) = 0. $ (1) 求 $a,b$ 的值；(2) 求 $ z(x,y) $ 的表达式.
explanation:
由 $u=x+ay$，$v=x+by$ 得 $z_x=z_u+z_v$，$z_y=az_u+bz_v$。代入原方程后，$z_{uu}$ 与 $z_{vv}$ 的系数分别为 $a^2-4a+3$、$b^2-4b+3$。令二者为 $0$，并由 $a\lt b$ 得 $a=1,b=3$，此时方程化为 $z_{uv}=0$。故 $z=f(x+y)+g(x+3y)$。由 $z(x,0)=\sin x$ 得 $f(x)+g(x)=\sin x$；由 $z_y(x,0)=0$ 得 $f'(x)+3g'(x)=0$。再由 $f'(x)+g'(x)=\cos x$，解得 $f'(x)=\frac{3}{2}\cos x$，$g'(x)=-\frac{1}{2}\cos x$。积分并结合 $f(x)+g(x)=\sin x$，得 
$$
z=\frac{3}{2}\sin(x+y)-\frac{1}{2}\sin(x+3y).
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 利用变量代换化简偏微分方程 / 线性变换

stem: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，作变量代换 $ \xi = x, \eta = y - x $，将方程 $ \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2} + 2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x \partial y} + \frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2} = 0 $ 化为以 $ \xi, \eta $ 为自变量的方程。
explanation:
由题，函数复合关系如图所示，所以 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta},\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{\partial}{\partial\xi}\big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\big)\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial}{\partial\eta}\big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\big)\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial}{\partial\xi}\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\Big)\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial}{\partial\eta}\Big(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}-\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\Big)\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}-\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}. 
$$
 故 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}=0, 
$$
 即 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}=0. 
$$

stem: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足等式 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + 3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} + \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $。确定 a, b 的值，使等式在变换 $ \xi = x + ay, \eta = bx + 2y (ab \neq 2) $ 下简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0 $。
explanation:
由 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}\xi&=x+ay,\\ \eta&=bx+2y\end{aligned}\right. $ 可得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}x&=\frac{a\eta-2\xi}{ab-2},\\ y&=\frac{b\xi-\eta}{ab-2}.\end{aligned}\right. $ 注意到 $ u=f(x,y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数。由链式法则， $ u=f(x(\xi,\eta),y(\xi,\eta)) $ 仍具有关于 $ \xi,\eta $ 的二阶连续偏导数，从而 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi} $。由链式法则可得， 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}, 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial x}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial x}\\&=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{align*}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+b\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(ab+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+2b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}},\end{align*} 
$$
 
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}&=\frac{\partial\left(a\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}+2\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\right)}{\partial y}=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta\partial\xi}\frac{\partial\xi}{\partial y}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}\frac{\partial\eta}{\partial y}\\&=a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+4a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}.\end{aligned} 
$$
 代入 $ 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0 $ ，整理得 
$$
 \left(a^{2}+3a+2\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left(2b^{2}+6b+4\right)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}+\left[3\left(a b+2\right)+4a+4b\right]\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0. 
$$
 由上式等价于 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0 $可得， 
$$
 \begin{cases}a^{2}+3a+2=0,\\2b^{2}+6b+4=0,\\3\left(ab+2\right)+4a+4b\neq0.\end{cases} 
$$
 由前两个方程解得 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-1,\\ b&=-1,\end{aligned}\right. $或 $ \left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-2,\\ b&=-2\end{aligned}\right. $（舍去ab=2的解）。 将这两组解代入 $ 3(ab+2)+4a+4b $均不为零，故这两组解均符合要求。
source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 38

stem: 设 $u(x,y)$ 有二阶连续偏导数，利用变换 $\xi=x+ay,\eta=x+by$，将方程 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=0$ 化为 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}=0$，求 $a,b$ 的值。
explanation: 视 $\xi$、$\eta$ 为中间变量，$x$、$y$ 为自变量。由已知，得 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\cdot1+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\cdot1$，$\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}\cdot a+\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}\cdot b$。这里 $\frac{\partial u}{\partial\xi}$、$\frac{\partial u}{\partial\eta}$ 是以 $\xi$、$\eta$ 为中间变量，$x$、$y$ 为自变量的二元函数，故 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$，$\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+2ab\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$，$\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}=a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+(a+b)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$。代入已知方程，得 $\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}+4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}+3\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=(1+4a+3a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi^{2}}+\left[2+4(a+b)+6ab\right]\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\xi\partial\eta}+(1+4b+3b^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial\eta^{2}}$。又由已知，得 $\begin{cases}1+4a+3a^{2}=0,\\1+4b+3b^{2}=0,\\2+4(a+b)+6ab\neq0,\end{cases}$ 联立①、②式解得 $\left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-1,\\ b&=-\frac{1}{3}\end{aligned}\right.$ 或 $\left\{\begin{aligned}a&=-\frac{1}{3},\\ b&=-1,\end{aligned}\right.$ 且都满足③式，故为所求。
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 利用变量代换化简偏微分方程 / 线性变换

stem: 设函数 $ u = f(x, y) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足等式 $ 4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + 12\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} + 5\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $。确定 $ a, b $ 的值，使等式在变换 $ \xi = x + ay, \eta = x + by $ 下简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0 $。
explanation:
由变换 $ \xi = x + ay $, $ \eta = x + by $，计算一阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial \xi} + \frac{\partial u}{\partial \eta}, \quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = a\frac{\partial u}{\partial \xi} + b\frac{\partial u}{\partial \eta}. 
$$
计算二阶偏导数：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi^{2}} + 2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi\partial \eta} + \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \eta^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} = a\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi^{2}} + (a+b)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi\partial \eta} + b\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \eta^{2}}, 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = a^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi^{2}} + 2ab\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi\partial \eta} + b^{2}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \eta^{2}}. 
$$
代入原方程 $ 4\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + 12\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} + 5\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} = 0 $，整理得：
$$
 (4 + 12a + 5a^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi^{2}} + (8 + 12(a+b) + 10ab)\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi\partial \eta} + (4 + 12b + 5b^{2})\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \eta^{2}} = 0. 
$$
为使方程简化为 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial \xi \partial \eta} = 0 $，需满足：
$$
 \begin{cases}4 + 12a + 5a^{2} = 0, \\ 4 + 12b + 5b^{2} = 0, \\ 8 + 12(a+b) + 10ab \neq 0.\end{cases} 
$$
解 $ 4 + 12a + 5a^{2} = 0 $ 得 $ a = -2 $ 或 $ a = -\frac{2}{5} $。同理，$ b = -2 $ 或 $ b = -\frac{2}{5} $。为使 $ \xi $ 与 $ \eta $ 线性无关，需 $ a \neq b $，且满足 $ 8 + 12(a+b) + 10ab \neq 0 $。因此有两组解：$ (a, b) = (-2, -\frac{2}{5}) $ 或 $ (a, b) = (-\frac{2}{5}, -2) $。
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 利用变量代换化简偏微分方程 / 线性变换、历年真题 / 数二 / 2010

stem: 已知函数 $ u(x,y) $ 满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}-4\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=0 $，求 $ a,b $ 的值，使得在变换 $ u(x,y)=v(x,y)e^{ax+by} $ 下，上述等式可化为不含 $ v(x,y) $ 的一阶偏导数的等式。
explanation:
由 $ u(x,y)=v(x,y)\mathrm{e}^{ax+by} $ 可得，
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\cdot av=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\cdot b v=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b v\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=a\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right)+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}+a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}\right)=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(2a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+a^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}\right). 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}=b\cdot\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+bv\right)+\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}+b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\right)=\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left(2b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}\right). 
$$
代入已知等式可得，
$$
 \mathrm{e}^{ax+by}\left[\left(2a\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+a^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}\right)-2\left(2b\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+b^{2}v+\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}\right)+3\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+av\right)-4\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+bv\right)\right]=0. 
$$
整理上式，可得
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}v}{\partial y^{2}}+(2a+3)\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}-(4b+4)\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+(a^{2}v-2b^{2}v+3a v-4b v)=0. 
$$
要使得式中不含有 $ v(x,y) $ 的一阶偏导数，需使 $ 2a+3=0,4b+4=0 $。解得 $ a=-\frac{3}{2},b=-1 $。
因此，$ a=-\frac{3}{2},b=-1 $。
source: 900 第四章数二 A 类37
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 利用变量代换化简偏微分方程 / 非线性变换

stem: 已知函数 $u(x,y)$ 满足 $2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}-2\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+3\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=0$，求 $a,b$ 的值使得在变换 $u(x,y)=v(x,y)\mathrm{e}^{ax+by}$ 之下，上述等式可化为函数 $v(x,y)$ 的不含一阶偏导数的等式。
explanation:
令 $g=ax+by$。由 $u=ve^g$，有
$$
u_x=e^g(v_x+av),\qquad u_{xx}=e^g(v_{xx}+2av_x+a^2v),
$$
$$
u_y=e^g(v_y+bv),\qquad u_{yy}=e^g(v_{yy}+2bv_y+b^2v).
$$
代入原方程并约去非零因子 $e^g$，得
$$
2v_{xx}-2v_{yy}+(4a+3)v_x+(-4b+3)v_y+(2a^2-2b^2+3a+3b)v=0.
$$
要消去一阶偏导数，须满足
$$
4a+3=0,\qquad -4b+3=0.
$$
故
$$
a=-\frac34,\qquad b=\frac34.
$$

stem: 设 $ z=\frac{2x}{x^{2}-y^{2}} $，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial^{n}z}{\partial y^{n}}\right|_{(2,1)}= $ ___.
explanation:
由 $ z=\frac{1}{x+y}-\frac{1}{y-x} $，得 $ z=\frac{x-y+x+y}{(x+y)(x-y)}=\frac{2x}{x^{2}-y^{2}} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial^{n}z}{\partial y^{n}}=\frac{\left(-1\right)^{n}n!}{\left(x+y\right)^{n+1}}-\frac{\left(-1\right)^{n}n!}{\left(y-x\right)^{n+1}},\quad \frac{\partial^{n}z}{\partial y^{n}}\bigg|_{(2,1)}=\frac{\left(-1\right)^{n}n!}{3^{n+1}}-\frac{\left(-1\right)^{n}n!}{\left(-1\right)^{n+1}}=\left[1+\frac{\left(-1\right)^{n}}{3^{n+1}}\right]n!. 
$$

options.label: B
options.content_md: $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)} $ 存在, $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)} $ 不存在

options.label: C
options.content_md: $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)} $, $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)} $ 均存在

options.label: D
options.content_md: $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)} $, $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)} $ 均不存在

explanation: 由 $ f(x, y) = \ln(y + |x \sin y|) $，得 $ f(0,1)=\ln1=0 $。根据偏导数定义，$ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(x,1)-f(0,1)}{x}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\ln(1+|x\sin1|)}{x} $。由于 $ \ln(1+|x\sin1|)\sim |x\sin1| $，故 $ \lim_{x\to0}\frac{|x\sin1|}{x}=\sin1\cdot\lim_{x\to0}\frac{|x|}{x} $ 不存在，所以 $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,1)} $ 不存在。而 $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)}=\lim_{y\to1}\frac{f(0,y)-f(0,1)}{y-1}=\lim_{y\to1}\frac{\ln y-0}{y-1}=\lim_{y\to1}\frac{\ln y}{y-1}=1 $，存在。因此应选 A。

explanation: 由 $ f(x,y)=|x|+y|y| $，得 $ f(0,0)=0 $。根据偏导数定义，$ f_{x}^{\prime}(0,0)=\lim_{\Delta x\to0}\frac{f(\Delta x,0)-f(0,0)}{\Delta x}=\lim_{\Delta x\to0}\frac{|\Delta x|}{\Delta x} $，该极限不存在，故 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(0,0) $ 不存在。$ f_{y}^{\prime}(0,0)=\lim_{\Delta y\to0}\frac{f(0,\Delta y)-f(0,0)}{\Delta y}=\lim_{\Delta y\to0}\frac{\Delta y\left|\Delta y\right|}{\Delta y}=\lim_{\Delta y\to0}|\Delta y|=0 $，存在。因此应选 C。

explanation: 由 $ f(x,y)=\arcsin\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{4}} $，得 $ f(0,0)=0 $。根据偏导数定义，$ f_{x}^{\prime}(0,0)=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(x,0)-f(0,0)}{x}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\arcsin|x|}{x} $。由于 $ \arcsin|x|\sim |x| $，故 $ \lim_{x\to0}\frac{|x|}{x} $ 不存在，所以 $ f_{x}^{\prime}(0,0) $ 不存在。$ f_{y}^{\prime}(0,0)=\lim_{y\to0}\frac{f(0,y)-f(0,0)}{y}=\lim_{y\to0}\frac{\arcsin y^{2}}{y} $。由于 $ \arcsin y^{2}\sim y^{2} $，故 $ \lim_{y\to0}\frac{y^{2}}{y}=0 $，存在。因此应选 B。

options.label: B
options.content_md: $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,0)} $ 存在, $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,0)} $ 不存在

options.label: D
options.content_md: $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,0)},\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,0)} $均不存在

explanation: 由 $ f(x,y)=\mathrm{e}^{|\sin x|}-\cos y $，得 $ f(0,0)=0 $。根据偏导数定义，$ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,0)}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f(x,0)-f(0,0)}{x}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\mathrm{e}^{\left|\sin x\right|}-1}{x} $。由于 $ \mathrm{e}^{\left|\sin x\right|}-1\sim \left|\sin x\right| $，故 $ \lim_{x\to0}\frac{\left|\sin x\right|}{x} $ 不存在（因为 $ \lim_{x\to0^{-}}\frac{\left|\sin x\right|}{x}=-1 $，$ \lim_{x\to0^{+}}\frac{\left|\sin x\right|}{x}=1 $），所以 $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,0)} $ 不存在。$ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,0)}=\lim_{y\to0}\frac{f(0,y)-f(0,0)}{y}=\lim_{y\to0}\frac{1-\cos y}{y} $。由于 $ 1-\cos y\sim \frac{y^{2}}{2} $，故 $ \lim_{y\to0}\frac{\frac{y^{2}}{2}}{y}=0 $，存在。因此应选 A。

options.content_md: 在点 $ (0,0) $ 处， $ f_{1}(x,y) $ 的偏导数存在， $ f_{2}(x,y) $ 的偏导数不存在.

options.label: D
options.content_md: 在点 $ (0,0) $ 处， $ f_{1}(x,y) $ 和 $ f_{2}(x,y) $ 的偏导数均不存在.

explanation:
根据偏导数的定义， 
$$
 \frac{\partial f_{1}}{\partial x}\bigg|_{(0,0)}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f_{1}(x,0)-f_{1}(0,0)}{x-0}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{\left|x\right|\sin\frac{1}{x^{2}}}{x}. 
$$
 由于 $ \lim_{x\to0}\frac{\left|x\right|\sin\frac{1}{x^{2}}}{x} $不存在，故 $ \left.\frac{\partial f_{1}}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,0)} $不存在。同理可得 $ \left.\frac{\partial f_{1}}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,0)} $也不存在。因此， $ f_{1}(x,y) $在点 $ (0,0) $处的偏导数不存在。
根据偏导数的定义， 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial f_{2}}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,0)}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{f_{2}(x,0)-f_{2}(0,0)}{x-0}=\lim_{x\to0}\frac{x^{2}\sin\frac{1}{|x|}}{x}=0. 
$$
 同理可得 $ \left.\frac{\partial f_{2}}{\partial y}\right|_{(0,0)}=0 $。因此， $ f_{2}(x,y) $在点 $ (0,0) $处的偏导数存在。
综上所述，应选 B.

explanation:

$$
\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=z\cdot\frac1y\left[\ln\left(\frac yx\right)-1\right].
$$

$$

stem: 设函数 $ f(x,y)=\sqrt{|xy|} $，求 $ \frac{\partial\left[f(x,y)\right]}{\partial x} $.
explanation:
为满足严格的数学语言与逻辑要求，我们需要先通过绝对值的定义将原函数化为分段函数，明确其在不同开区域内的表达式。对于区域边界（即坐标轴），不能默认导数存在，**必须**使用偏导数的极限定义进行验证。

**第一步：依绝对值定义展开函数**
原函数 $f(x,y) = \sqrt{|xy|}$ 可严格展开为：
$$
f(x,y) =
\begin{cases}
\sqrt{xy}, & xy > 0 \\
\sqrt{-xy}, & xy < 0 \\
0, & xy = 0
\end{cases}
$$

**第二步：严格分类讨论求 $\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}$**

**情形一：点在坐标轴外（即 $xy \neq 0$）**
在 $xy > 0$ 和 $xy < 0$ 的开区域内，函数由初等函数复合而成，其偏导数必定存在，可直接使用求导法则。
1. **当 $xy > 0$ 时（第一、三象限内）**：
   此时局部函数为 $f(x,y) = \sqrt{xy}$，将 $y$ 视为常数对 $x$ 求导：
   
$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{xy}} \cdot \frac{\partial (xy)}{\partial x} = \frac{y}{2\sqrt{xy}}
$$
2. **当 $xy < 0$ 时（第二、四象限内）**：
   此时局部函数为 $f(x,y) = \sqrt{-xy}$，将 $y$ 视为常数对 $x$ 求导：
   
$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{-xy}} \cdot \frac{\partial (-xy)}{\partial x} = \frac{-y}{2\sqrt{-xy}}
$$

**情形二：点在坐标轴上（即 $xy = 0$）**
在分界线上，函数表达式发生切换，必须使用偏导数的极限定义。
3. **当 $y = 0$ 且 $x \in \mathbb{R}$ 时（即整条 $x$ 轴，含原点）**：
   设该点为 $(x_0, 0)$。根据定义：
   
$$
\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(x_0,0)} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \frac{f(x_0+\Delta x, 0) - f(x_0, 0)}{\Delta x}
$$
   由于对于任意实数 $x$，恒有 $f(x, 0) = \sqrt{|x \cdot 0|} = 0$，代入上式得：
   
$$
\lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \frac{0 - 0}{\Delta x} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} 0 = 0
$$
   因此，在此区域对 $x$ 的偏导数存在，且为 $0$。

4. **当 $x = 0$ 且 $y \neq 0$ 时（即 $y$ 轴上除原点外的点）**：
   设该点为 $(0, y_0)$，其中 $y_0 \neq 0$。根据定义：
   
$$
\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right|_{(0,y_0)} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \frac{f(0+\Delta x, y_0) - f(0, y_0)}{\Delta x} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \frac{\sqrt{|\Delta x \cdot y_0|} - 0}{\Delta x}
$$
   
$$
= \sqrt{|y_0|} \lim_{\Delta x \to 0} \frac{\sqrt{|\Delta x|}}{\Delta x}
$$
   分别计算该极限的左右极限：
   * **右极限** ($\Delta x \to 0^+$)：此时 $|\Delta x| = \Delta x$
       $$\lim_{\Delta x \to 0^+} \frac{\sqrt{\Delta x}}{\Delta x} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0^+} \frac{1}{\sqrt{\Delta x}} = +\infty$$
   * **左极限** ($\Delta x \to 0^-$)：此时 $|\Delta x| = -\Delta x$
       $$\lim_{\Delta x \to 0^-} \frac{\sqrt{-\Delta x}}{\Delta x} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0^-} \frac{\sqrt{-\Delta x}}{-(-\Delta x)} = \lim_{\Delta x \to 0^-} \frac{-1}{\sqrt{-\Delta x}} = -\infty$$
   左右极限不趋于同一个有限常数（且均发散），极限不存在。因此，在此区域对 $x$ 的偏导数**不存在**。

---

**第三步：结论汇总**
经过严格分类验证，偏导数 $\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}$ 的最终结果为：

$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial x} =
\begin{cases}
\frac{y}{2\sqrt{xy}}, & xy > 0 \\
\frac{-y}{2\sqrt{-xy}}, & xy < 0 \\
0, & y = 0 \\
\text{不存在}, & x = 0 \text{ 且 } y \neq 0
\end{cases}
$$

stem: 设 $ z = \ln(\sqrt{x} + \sqrt{y}) $，则 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___.
explanation:
计算偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{x} + \sqrt{y}} \cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y})} 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{x} + \sqrt{y}} \cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{y}} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{y}(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y})} 
$$
 因此， 
$$
 x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = x \cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{x}(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y})} + y \cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{y}(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y})} = \frac{\sqrt{x}}{2(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y})} + \frac{\sqrt{y}}{2(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y})} = \frac{\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y}}{2(\sqrt{x}+\sqrt{y})} = \frac{1}{2}. 
$$

stem: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 满足 $ f\left(x+y,\frac{y}{x}\right)=x^{2}-y^{2} $，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\right|_{u=1,v=1} $ 与 $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right|_{u=1,v=1}, $ 依次是（）。
explanation:
这是一道经典的多元复合函数求导问题。在处理这类抽象函数表达式时，通常有两种核心解法：**换元法**（求出具体解析式）和**复合函数求导法**（利用链式法则构建方程组）。

以下是这两种方法的详细解析过程，可以作为严谨的教学参考：

### 方法一：换元法（求出函数的显式表达式）

这种方法的思路是将变量 $x, y$ 反解为 $u, v$ 的表达式，从而求出 $f(u, v)$ 的具体解析式，再进行偏导数计算。

**第一步：变量代换与反解**
令：
$$
u = x + y
$$
$$
v = \frac{y}{x}
$$

由第二个式子可得 $ y = vx $，将其代入第一个式子：
$$
u = x + vx = x(1+v)
$$

从中反解出 $x$ 和 $y$：
$$
x = \frac{u}{1+v}
$$
$$
y = \frac{uv}{1+v}
$$

**第二步：求 $f(u,v)$ 的解析式**
将反解出的 $x, y$ 代入原等式右侧 $x^2 - y^2$ 中：
$$
f(u,v) = x^2 - y^2 = (x+y)(x-y)
$$
$$
f(u,v) = u \left( \frac{u}{1+v} - \frac{uv}{1+v} \right) = u \left( \frac{u(1-v)}{1+v} \right)
$$
$$
f(u,v) = \frac{1-v}{1+v} u^2
$$

**第三步：分别求偏导数并代入数值**
对 $u$ 求偏导：
$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} = \frac{1-v}{1+v} \cdot 2u
$$
将 $u=1, v=1$ 代入：
$$
\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\right|_{u=1,v=1} = \frac{1-1}{1+1} \cdot 2(1) = 0
$$

对 $v$ 求偏导（将 $u$ 视为常数）：
$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial v} = u^2 \cdot \frac{(-1)(1+v) - (1-v)(1)}{(1+v)^2} = u^2 \cdot \frac{-1-v-1+v}{(1+v)^2} = \frac{-2u^2}{(1+v)^2}
$$
将 $u=1, v=1$ 代入：
$$
\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right|_{u=1,v=1} = \frac{-2(1)^2}{(1+1)^2} = \frac{-2}{4} = -\frac{1}{2}
$$

---

### 方法二：复合函数求导法（链式法则构建方程组）

若原函数难以直接反解，利用全导数与链式法则构建线性方程组是更具普适性的严谨解法。

**第一步：确定对应点的坐标**
已知目标点为 $u=1, v=1$。我们需要先求出此时对应的 $x, y$ 的值：
$$
\begin{cases} x+y=1 \\ \frac{y}{x}=1 \end{cases} \implies \begin{cases} x=\frac{1}{2} \\ y=\frac{1}{2} \end{cases}
$$

**第二步：利用链式法则求导**
对等式 $f\left(x+y, \frac{y}{x}\right) = x^2 - y^2$ 两边分别对 $x$ 和 $y$ 求偏导。
令 $u = x+y$, $v = \frac{y}{x}$，则有：

两边对 $x$ 求偏导：
$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = 2x
$$
$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} \cdot 1 + \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} \cdot \left(-\frac{y}{x^2}\right) = 2x \quad \cdots \text{(式1)}
$$

两边对 $y$ 求偏导：
$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} \frac{\partial v}{\partial y} = -2y
$$
$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} \cdot 1 + \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} \cdot \frac{1}{x} = -2y \quad \cdots \text{(式2)}
$$

**第三步：代入坐标解方程组**
将 $x=\frac{1}{2}, y=\frac{1}{2}$ 代入 (式1) 和 (式2)：
$$
\begin{cases} \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} \left(-\frac{1/2}{1/4}\right) = 2(\frac{1}{2}) \\ \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} \left(\frac{1}{1/2}\right) = -2(\frac{1}{2}) \end{cases} \implies \begin{cases} \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} - 2\frac{\partial f}{\partial v} = 1 \\ \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} + 2\frac{\partial f}{\partial v} = -1 \end{cases}
$$

将两式相加：
$$
2\frac{\partial f}{\partial u} = 0 \implies \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} = 0
$$

将两式相减：
$$
4\frac{\partial f}{\partial v} = -2 \implies \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} = -\frac{1}{2}
$$

---

**最终结论：**
$\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\right|_{u=1,v=1}$ 与 $\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right|_{u=1,v=1}$ 依次是 **$0$** 和 **$-\frac{1}{2}$**。

stem: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 满足 $ f\left(2x + y, \frac{2y}{x}\right) = 4x^2 - y^2 $，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\right|_{\substack{u=1\\ v=0}}, \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right|_{\substack{u=1\\ v=0}} $ 依次是（）
explanation:
解法1：由 $ u = 2x + y $, $ v = \frac{2y}{x} $ 解得 $ x = \frac{2u}{4+v} $, $ y = \frac{uv}{4+v} $，故 $ f(u,v) = 4\left(\frac{2u}{4+v}\right)^{2} - \left(\frac{u v}{4+v}\right)^{2} = \frac{u^{2}\left(16-v^{2}\right)}{\left(4+v\right)^{2}} = u^{2}\frac{4-v}{4+v} = u^{2}\left(\frac{8}{4+v}-1\right) $。因此，$ \frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\bigg|_{\substack{u=1\\ v=0}} = 2u\bigg(\frac{8}{4+v}-1\bigg)\bigg|_{\substack{u=1\\ v=0}} = 2 $，$ \frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\bigg|_{\substack{u=1\\ v=0}} = u^{2}\cdot\frac{-8}{\left(4+v\right)^{2}}\bigg|_{\substack{u=1\\ v=0}} = -\frac{1}{2} $。应选D。
解法2：通过全微分比较系数，当 $ u = 1, v = 0 $ 时，解得 $ x = \frac{1}{2} $, $ y = 0 $，代入方程组可得 $ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial u}\right|_{\substack{u=1\\ v=0}} = 2 $，$ \left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}\right|_{\substack{u=1\\ v=0}} = -\frac{1}{2} $。应选D。

stem: 设函数 $F(x,y) = \int_{0}^{x+y} \frac{\cos t}{1+t} dt$，则 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}\right|_{x=-1\atop y=1} =$ ___。
explanation: 令 $f(u)=\int_0^u\frac{\cos t}{1+t}dt$，则 $F(x,y)=f(x+y)$，$f'(u)=\frac{\cos u}{1+u}$。因此 $\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}=\frac{\cos(x+y)}{1+x+y}$，$\frac{\partial^2F}{\partial x^2}=\frac{-\sin(x+y)(1+x+y)-\cos(x+y)}{(1+x+y)^2}$。代入 $x=-1,y=1$，得 $\left.\frac{\partial^2F}{\partial x^2}\right|_{(-1,1)}=-1$。

stem: 设函数 $f(x,y)=\int_{0}^{xy}\mathrm{e}^{xt^{2}}\mathrm{d}t$，则 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}=$ ___
explanation:
由于 $f(x,y)$ 的二阶偏导数连续，故 $\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial y\partial x}$。先对 $y$ 求偏导： 
$$
\frac{\partial f}{\partial y}=x\mathrm{e}^{x^{3}y^{2}}
$$
 再对 $x$ 求偏导： 
$$
\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial y\partial x}=\mathrm{e}^{x^{3}y^{2}}+x\cdot\mathrm{e}^{x^{3}y^{2}}\cdot3x^{2}y^{2}=(3x^{3}y^{2}+1)\mathrm{e}^{x^{3}y^{2}}
$$
 代入 $x=1, y=1$ 得 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}=4e$。

explanation:
由于 $f(x,y)$ 的二阶偏导数连续，故 $\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial y\partial x}=\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y}$。先对 $x$ 求偏导：

$$
 再对 $y$ 求偏导：

\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y}=4xy\mathrm{e}^{x^{2}y^{2}}(1+x^{2}y^{2})
$$
 代入 $x=1, y=1$ 得 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial y\partial x}\right|_{(1,1)}=8e$。

stem: 设函数 $ u(x,y)=\varphi(x+y)+\varphi(x-y)+\int_{x-y}^{x+y}\psi(t)\mathrm{d}t $，其中函数 $ \varphi $ 具有二阶导数， $ \psi $ 具有一阶导数，则必有
explanation:
因 $ u(x,\ y)=\varphi(x+y)+\varphi(x-y)+\int_{x-y}^{x+y}\psi(t)\mathrm{d}t $，由变限积分求导公式：$ \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}\left[\int_{h(x)}^{g(x)}f(t)\mathrm{d}t\right]=g^{\prime}(x)f[g(x)]-h^{\prime}(x)f[h(x)] $，可得：
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}&=\varphi^{\prime}(x+y)+\varphi^{\prime}(x-y)+\psi(x+y)-\psi(x-y)\\ \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}&=\varphi^{\prime}(x+y)-\varphi^{\prime}(x-y)+\psi(x+y)+\psi(x-y)\end{aligned} 
$$
进而求二阶偏导：
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}&=\varphi^{\prime\prime}(x+y)+\varphi^{\prime\prime}(x-y)+\psi^{\prime}(x+y)-\psi^{\prime}(x-y)\\ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}&=\varphi^{\prime\prime}(x+y)-\varphi^{\prime\prime}(x-y)+\psi^{\prime}(x+y)+\psi^{\prime}(x-y)\\ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}}&=\varphi^{\prime\prime}(x+y)+\varphi^{\prime\prime}(x-y)+\psi^{\prime}(x+y)-\psi^{\prime}(x-y)\end{aligned} 
$$
因此，$ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}}=\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial y^{2}} $。

stem: 已知 $ f(t) $ 连续，令 $ F(x, y) = \int_{0}^{x-y} (x-y-t) f(t) \, dt $，则（）

options.label: A
options.content_md: $ \frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}. $

options.label: B
options.content_md: $ \frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}. $

options.label: C
options.content_md: $ \frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}. $

options.label: D
options.content_md: $ \frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial F}{\partial y}, \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = -\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}. $

explanation:
由 $ F(x,y)=\int_{0}^{x-y}(x-y-t)f(t)dt=(x-y)\int_{0}^{x-y}f(t)dt-\int_{0}^{x-y}tf(t)dt $，求偏导：
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}&=\int_{0}^{x-y}f(t)dt+(x-y)f(x-y)-(x-y)f(x-y)=\int_{0}^{x-y}f(t)dt\\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}&=f(x-y)\\ \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}&=-\int_{0}^{x-y}f(t)dt-(x-y)f(x-y)+(x-y)f(x-y)=-\int_{0}^{x-y}f(t)dt\\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}&=f(x-y)\end{aligned} 
$$
因此，$ \frac{\partial F}{\partial x} = -\frac{\partial F}{\partial y} $，且 $ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} = \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}} $。

stem: 设 $ F(x, y) = \int_{0}^{x-y} (x - y - t) e^{t} \, dt $，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}} = \_\_\_\_\_\_ . $
explanation:
由 $ F(x,y)=\int_{0}^{x-y}(x-y-t)\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t=(x-y)\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t-\int_{0}^{x-y}t\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t $，求偏导：
$$
 \begin{aligned}\frac{\partial F}{\partial x}&=\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t+(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}-(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}=\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t\\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}&=\mathrm{e}^{x-y}\\ \frac{\partial F}{\partial y}&=-\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t-(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}+(x-y)\mathrm{e}^{x-y}=-\int_{0}^{x-y}\mathrm{e}^{t}\mathrm{d}t\\ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}&=\mathrm{e}^{x-y}\end{aligned} 
$$
故 $ \frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}F}{\partial y^{2}}=\mathrm{e}^{x-y}+\mathrm{e}^{x-y}=2\mathrm{e}^{x-y} $。

stem: 设函数 $ u(x,y) = f(xy) + \int_{0}^{x+y} f(x+y-t) \, dt $, $ v(x,y) = yf(x+y) + \int_{y-x}^{y} f(x+t) \, dt $, 其中函数 $ f(t) $ 具有一阶导数，则下列结论中，正确的是（）

options.label: A
options.content_md: 若 x = y，则 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} $.

options.label: B
options.content_md: 若 x = y，则 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $.

options.label: C
options.content_md: 若 x ≠ y，则 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} ≠ \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} $.

options.label: D
options.content_md: 若 x ≠ y，则 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} ≠ \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $.

explanation:
首先化简 $ u(x,y) $ 和 $ v(x,y) $。
$$
 \begin{aligned}&u\left(x,y\right)\xlongequal{s=x+y-t}f(xy)+\int_{x+y}^{0}f(s)\mathrm{d}\left(-s\right)=f(xy)+\int_{0}^{x+y}f(s)\mathrm{d}s,\\&v\left(x,y\right)\xlongequal{s=x+t}yf(x+y)+\int_{y}^{x+y}f(s)\mathrm{d}s.\end{aligned} 
$$
分别计算 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x},\frac{\partial u}{\partial y},\frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=y f^{\prime}(x y)+f(x+y), 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=x f^{\prime}(x y)+f(x+y), 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial v}{\partial x}=y f^{\prime}(x+y)+f(x+y). 
$$
若 x = y，则 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} $。因此，应选 A。
下面说明选项 B、C、D 不正确。由于当 x = y 时，不能保证 $ f'(xy) = f'(x + y) $，故 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} $ 和 $ \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $ 不一定相等。选项 B 不正确。取 $ f \equiv 0 $，可知 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial u}{\partial y} = \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = 0 $。选项 C 和 D 不正确。
source: 900 第四章数二 A 类 10

stem: 已知 $ f(x,y)=x^{2}\arctan\frac{y}{x}-y^{2}\arctan\frac{x}{y} $，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y} $
explanation: 第一步：求一阶偏导。$ f(x,\ y)=x^{2}\arctan\frac{y}{x}-y^{2}\arctan\frac{x}{y} $。对 x 求导时，将 y 看成常数。$ \frac{\partial f}{\partial x}=2x\arctan\frac{y}{x}+x^{2}\cdot\frac{1}{1+\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)^{2}}\cdot\left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right)-y^{2}\cdot\frac{1}{1+\left(\frac{x}{y}\right)^{2}}\cdot\frac{1}{y}=2x\arctan\frac{y}{x}-\frac{x^{2}y}{x^{2}+y^{2}}-\frac{y^{3}}{x^{2}+y^{2}} $。第二步：求二阶偏导。$ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}\right)}{\partial y} $。对 y 求导时，将 x 看成常数。$ \begin{aligned}&=\frac{\partial\left(2x\arctan\frac{y}{x}-\frac{x^{2}y}{x^{2}+y^{2}}-\frac{y^{3}}{x^{2}+y^{2}}\right)}{\partial y}\\&=2x\cdot\frac{1}{1+\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)^{2}}\cdot\frac{1}{x}-\frac{x^{2}\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)-x^{2}y\cdot2y}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)^{2}}-\frac{3y^{2}\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)-y^{3}\cdot2y}{(x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}}\\&=\frac{2x^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}}-\frac{x^{4}-x^{2}y^{2}}{(x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}}-\frac{3x^{2}y^{2}+y^{4}}{(x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}}\\&=\frac{2x^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}}-\frac{x^{4}-x^{2}y^{2}+3x^{2}y^{2}+y^{4}}{(x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}}\\&=\frac{2x^{2}\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)}{(x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}}-\frac{x^{4}+2x^{2}y^{2}+y^{4}}{(x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}}\\&=\frac{2x^{4}+2x^{2}y^{2}-x^{4}-2x^{2}y^{2}-y^{4}}{(x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}}\\&=\frac{x^{4}-y^{4}}{(x^{2}+y^{2})^{2}}=\frac{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)\left(x^{2}-y^{2}\right)}{\left(x^{2}+y^{2}\right)^{2}}\\&=\frac{x^{2}-y^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}}.\end{aligned} $

stem: 设 $ u = e^{-x} \sin \frac{x}{y} $，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2} u}{\partial x \partial y} $ 在点 $ \left(2, \frac{1}{\pi}\right) $ 处的值为 ___
explanation: 第一步：求 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} $。由于 $ u = e^{-x} \sin \frac{x}{y} $，则对 x 求偏导，y 看做常数。$ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=-e^{-x}\sin\frac{x}{y}+e^{-x}\cos\frac{x}{y}\cdot\frac{1}{y}=e^{-x}\left(\frac{1}{y}\cos\frac{x}{y}-\sin\frac{x}{y}\right) $。第二步：求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} $。故 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}\right) $。对 y 求偏导，x 看做常数。$ \begin{aligned}&=e^{-x}\left[-\frac{1}{y^{2}}\cos\frac{x}{y}+\frac{1}{y}\cdot\left(-\sin\frac{x}{y}\right)\left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right)-\cos\frac{x}{y}\cdot\left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right)\right]\\&=e^{-x}\left(\frac{x}{y^{3}}\sin\frac{x}{y}+\frac{x-1}{y^{2}}\cos\frac{x}{y}\right)\end{aligned} $。于是 $ \frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y}\Big\vert_{\left(2,\ \frac{1}{\pi}\right)}=\mathrm{e}^{-2}\left(2\pi^{3}\sin2\pi+\pi^{2}\cos2\pi\right)=\mathrm{e}^{-2}\cdot\pi^{2}=\left(\frac{\pi}{\mathrm{e}}\right)^{2} $。
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元函数求偏导 / 二阶偏导 / 常规

stem: 设 $ f(x,y)=\ln|x+y|-\sin(xy) $，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y} $ 在点 $ (1,\pi) $ 处的值为 ___.
explanation: 根据题目提供的计算过程，但原文存在明显乱码和错误，无法直接提取完整正确的解析。题目要求计算 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y} $ 在点 $ (1,\pi) $ 处的值。正确的解析应首先计算一阶偏导数 $ \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} = \frac{1}{x+y} - y\cos(xy) $，然后计算二阶混合偏导数 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial x\partial y} = -\frac{1}{(x+y)^2} - \cos(xy) + xy\sin(xy) $，最后代入点 $ (1, \pi) $ 得到 $ -\frac{1}{(1+\pi)^2} - \cos(\pi) + \pi\sin(\pi) = -\frac{1}{(1+\pi)^2} + 1 $。

stem: 设 $ z = xy f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $， $ f(u) $ 可导，则 $ xz_x' + yz_y' = $ ___.
explanation:
第一步：求偏导。
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=yf\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)-\frac{y^{2}}{x}f'\left(\frac{y}{x}\right), 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=xf\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+yf'\left(\frac{y}{x}\right). 
$$
第二步：求解 $ xz_{x}^{\prime} + yz_{y}^{\prime} $。
$$
 \begin{aligned} xz'_{x}+yz'_{y}&=xyf\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)-y^{2}f'\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+xyf\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+y^{2}f'\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\\&=2xyf\left(\frac{y}{x}\right).\end{aligned} 
$$

stem: 设函数 $ f(u) $ 可导， $ z = yf\left(\frac{y^{2}}{x}\right) $，则 $ 2x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___.
explanation:
设 $ u = \frac{y^{2}}{x} $，则 $ z = y f(u) $。
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y f'(u)\cdot\left(-\frac{y^{2}}{x^{2}}\right), 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=f(u)+y f'(u)\cdot\frac{2y}{x}. 
$$
因此，
$$
 2x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=2x\left[-\frac{y^{3}}{x^{2}}f'(u)\right]+y\left[f(u)+\frac{2y^{2}}{x}f'(u)\right]=-\frac{2y^{3}}{x}f'(u)+yf(u)+\frac{2y^{3}}{x}f'(u)=yf(u)=y f\left(\frac{y^{2}}{x}\right). 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元复合函数求偏导 / f(u) / 常规一阶

stem: 设函数 $ f(u) $ 可导， $ z = yf\left(x^{y^{2}}\right) $，则 $ 2x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___.
explanation:
由已知可得，
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y f'(x^{y^{2}})\cdot(y^{2}x^{y^{2}-1}),\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=f(x^{y^{2}})+y f'(x^{y^{2}})\cdot(x^{y^{2}}\cdot\ln x\cdot2y), 
$$
所以
$$
 2x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=2y^{3}\cdot x^{y^{2}}\cdot(1+\ln x)\cdot f'(x^{y^{2}})+yf(x^{y^{2}}). 
$$

stem: 设函数 $ f(u) $ 可导， $ z = f(\sin y - \sin x) + xy $，则 $ \frac{1}{\cos x} \cdot \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{1}{\cos y} \cdot \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___.
explanation:
设 $ u = \sin y - \sin x $。由复合函数求导法得
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+y = f'(\sin y-\sin x)(-\cos x)+y, 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=f'(u)\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+x = f'(\sin y-\sin x)(\cos y)+x. 
$$
因此，
$$
 \frac{1}{\cos x}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{1}{\cos y}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}= \frac{1}{\cos x}[f'(u)(-\cos x)+y]+\frac{1}{\cos y}[f'(u)(\cos y)+x] = -f'(u)+\frac{y}{\cos x}+f'(u)+\frac{x}{\cos y} = \frac{y}{\cos x}+\frac{x}{\cos y}. 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元复合函数求偏导 / f(u) / 常规一阶

stem: 设函数 $ f(u) $ 可导， $ z = f(\cos y - \cos x) + xy $，则 $ \frac{1}{\sin x} \cdot \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + \frac{1}{\sin y} \cdot \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___.
explanation:
因为 $ z = f(\cos y - \cos x) + xy $，所以 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f^{\prime}(\cos y-\cos x)\cdot\sin x+y,\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=f^{\prime}(\cos y-\cos x)\cdot(-\sin y)+x. 
$$
 从而 
$$
 \frac{1}{\sin x}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{1}{\sin y}\cdot\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{y}{\sin x}+\frac{x}{\sin y}. 
$$

stem: 设 $ f(u) $ 可导, $ z = xy f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $, 若 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = y^2 (\ln y - \ln x) $, 则（）
explanation:
分别求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $ 和 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $. 利用链式法则, 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+x y f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\cdot\left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right)=y f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)-\frac{y^{2}}{x}f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+x y f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)\cdot\frac{1}{x}=x f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+y f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right). 
$$
 于是, $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=2xyf\left(\frac{y}{x}\right). $ 与 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = y^{2} (\ln y - \ln x) = y^{2} \ln \frac{y}{x} $ 比较可得， $ f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) = \frac{y}{2x} \ln \frac{y}{x} $. 从而， $ f(u) = \frac{1}{2} u \ln u $， $ f'(u) = \frac{1}{2} (\ln u + 1) $. 因此， $ f(1)=0,f'(1)=\frac{1}{2} $. 应选 B.
source: 2022数一；26 版 1000 第十三章基础 14

stem: 设函数 $ z = \sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}} f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $，且 $ f(u) $ 可导，若 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = \frac{2y^{2}}{\sqrt{x^{2} + y^{2}}} $，则
explanation:
$$
 z_{x}^{\prime}=\frac{x}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}f\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big)-\frac{y\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}{x^{2}}f^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big), 
$$
 
$$
 z_{_{y}}^{\prime}=\frac{y}{\sqrt{x^{^{2}}+y^{^{2}}}}f\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big)+\frac{\sqrt{x^{^{2}}+y^{^{2}}}}{x}f^{\prime}\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big), 
$$
 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $，则 
$$
 \sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)=\frac{2y^{2}}{\sqrt{x^{2}+y^{2}}}, 
$$
 
$$
 f\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big)=\frac{2y^{2}}{x^{2}+y^{2}}=\frac{2\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big)^{2}}{1+\Big(\frac{y}{x}\Big)^{2}}, 
$$
 
$$
 f(x)=\frac{2x^{2}}{1+x^{2}}. 
$$
 则 $ f(1)=1, f'(1)=1 $ ，故应选(D).

stem: 已知函数 $ f(u) $ 可导，二元函数 $ z(x, y) = f(xy) f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $ 满足 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = 2xy e^{xy + \frac{y}{x}} $，则下列关于函数 $ f(u) $ 的说法中，正确的是（）

options.label: A
options.content_md: 曲线 $ y = f(u) $ 是凸曲线.

options.label: B
options.content_md: 曲线 $ y = f(u) $ 是凹曲线.

options.label: C
options.content_md: 曲线 $ y = f(u) $ 存在拐点.

options.label: D
options.content_md: 曲线 $ y = f(u) $ 存在渐近线.

explanation:
首先计算 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $ 和 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $. 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=y f^{\prime}(x y)f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)f(x y), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=x f^{\prime}(x y)f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+\frac{1}{x}f^{\prime}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)f(x y). 
$$
 于是 
$$
 x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=2xyf^{\prime}(xy)f\left(\frac{y}{x}\right). 
$$
 从而当 $ x\neq0,y\neq0 $时，可得令 $ u = xy, v = \frac{y}{x} $，则 $ f'(u)f(v) = e^{u+v} $。由此可得 
$$
 \frac{f^{\prime}(u)}{e^{u}}=\frac{e^{v}}{f(v)}. 
$$
 由(1)式可得，固定 $ v=v_{0} $，对任意u，均有 $ \frac{f^{\prime}(u)}{e^{u}}=\frac{e^{v_{0}}}{f(v_{0})} $。从而 $ \frac{f^{\prime}(u)}{e^{u}}=\lambda $，其中 $ \lambda $为常数。于是， $ f^{\prime}(u)=\lambda e^{u} $， $ f(u)=\lambda e^{u}+C $。另一方面，由(1)式可得 
$$
 \frac{e^{v}}{f(v)}=\lambda,\quad 即 f(v)=\frac{1}{\lambda}e^{v}. 
$$
 比较 $ f(u) $与 $ f(v) $的表达式可得， $ C=0,\lambda=\frac{1}{\lambda} $. 因此， $ \lambda=\pm1,f(u)=\pm\mathrm{e}^{u} $ 由于根据题干条件无法确定 $ f(u) $的符号，故选项A和B均不正确。由于 $ y = e^{u} $ 为凹曲线， $ y = -e^{u} $ 为凸曲线，故它们均没有拐点，选项 C 不正确。由于曲线 $ y = e^{u} $ 和 $ y = -e^{u} $ 均存在水平渐近线 y = 0，故选项 D 正确。综上所述，应选D.
source: 900 第四章数二 B 类 10

stem: 设 $ z = f\left(\ln x + \frac{1}{y}\right) $，其中函数 $ f(u) $ 可微，则 $ x \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} + y^{2} \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___
explanation:
利用链式法则，
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f'\left(\ln x+\frac{1}{y}\right)\cdot\frac{1}{x},\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=f'\left(\ln x+\frac{1}{y}\right)\cdot\left(-\frac{1}{y^{2}}\right). 
$$
因此，
$$
 x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+y^{2}\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=f'\left(\ln x+\frac{1}{y}\right)-f'\left(\ln x+\frac{1}{y}\right)=0. 
$$

stem: 设 $ z=\frac{y}{x}f(xy) $，其中函数 $ f $ 可微，则 $ \frac{x}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}= $（）
explanation:
（法一）用链式法则分别求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $， $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f(xy)+\frac{y}{x}f'(xy)\cdot y=-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f(xy)+\frac{y^{2}}{x}f'(xy), 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+\frac{y}{x}f'(xy)\cdot x=\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+y f'(xy). 
$$
因此，
$$
 \frac{x}{y}\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+yf'(xy)+\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+yf'(xy)=2yf'(xy). 
$$
应选 A。
（法二）利用全微分形式的不变性。
$$
 \begin{aligned}\mathrm{d}z&=f(xy)\mathrm{d}\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)+\frac{y}{x}\mathrm{d}[f(xy)]\\&=-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f(xy)\mathrm{d}x+\frac{1}{x}f(xy)\mathrm{d}y+\frac{y}{x}f'(xy)\cdot y\mathrm{d}x+\frac{y}{x}f'(xy)\cdot x\mathrm{d}y\\&=\left[\frac{y^{2}}{x}f'(xy)-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f(xy)\right]\mathrm{d}x+\left[yf'(xy)+\frac{1}{x}f(xy)\right]\mathrm{d}y.\end{aligned} 
$$
因此，
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f(xy)+\frac{y^{2}}{x}f'(xy),\qquad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+yf'(xy). 
$$
其余同法一。

stem: 设 $ z=\frac{1}{x}f(xy)+y\varphi(x+y) $， $ f,\varphi $ 具有二阶连续导数，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}= $ ___
explanation:
第一步：求 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=-\frac{1}{x^{2}}f(xy)+\frac{1}{x}\cdot yf^{\prime}(xy)+y\varphi^{\prime}(x+y). 
$$
第二步：求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=yf^{\prime\prime}(xy)+\varphi^{\prime}(x+y)+y\varphi^{\prime\prime}(x+y). 
$$

stem: 设 $ z = xf(x - y) + yg(x + y) $，其中 f 与 g 有二阶连续导数，则 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}} - \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}} $ 等于
explanation: 由 $ z = xf(x - y) + yg(x + y) $ 得 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f+x f^{\prime}+y g^{\prime},\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=-x f^{\prime}+g+y g^{\prime} $，所以 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}=f^{\prime}+f^{\prime}+x f^{\prime \prime}+y g^{\prime \prime}=2f^{\prime}+x f^{\prime \prime}+y g^{\prime \prime} $， $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=x f^{\prime \prime}+g^{\prime}+g^{\prime}+y g^{\prime \prime}=x f^{\prime \prime}+2g^{\prime}+y g^{\prime \prime} $，故 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x^{2}}-\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial y^{2}}=2f^{\prime}-2g^{\prime}=2(f^{\prime}-g^{\prime}) $，应选(A)。

stem: 设  $ u = yf\left(\frac{x}{y}\right) + xg\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $，其中 f, g 具有二阶连续导数，求  $ x\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x^{2}} + y\frac{\partial^{2}u}{\partial x\partial y} $.
explanation:
函数
$$u=yf\left(\frac{x}{y}\right)+xg\left(\frac{y}{x}\right)$$是关于 $x,y$ 的一阶齐次函数。由欧拉公式
$$xu_x+yu_y=u.$$两边对 $x$ 求偏导，得到
$$u_x+xu_{xx}+yu_{xy}=u_x,$$因此
$$xu_{xx}+yu_{xy}=0.$$

stem:
设 $f(u)$ 具有二阶连续导数，且
$$
g(x,y)=f\left(\frac yx\right)+yf\left(\frac xy\right).
$$
求
$$
x^2\frac{\partial^2g}{\partial x^2}
-y^2\frac{\partial^2g}{\partial y^2}.
$$
explanation:
令
$$
u=\frac yx,
\;
v=\frac xy.
$$
对第一项 $f(u)$ 求二阶偏导，得到
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x^2}f(u)
&=\frac{2u}{x^2}f'(u)+\frac{u^2}{x^2}f''(u),\\
\frac{\partial^2}{\partial y^2}f(u)
&=\frac1{x^2}f''(u).
\end{aligned}
$$
对第二项 $yf(v)$ 求二阶偏导，得到
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial^2}{\partial x^2}[yf(v)]
&=\frac1y f''(v),\\
\frac{\partial^2}{\partial y^2}[yf(v)]
&=\frac{v^2}{y}f''(v).
\end{aligned}
$$
因此
$$
\begin{aligned}
x^2g_{xx}-y^2g_{yy}
&=2u f'(u)+u^2f''(u)-\frac{y^2}{x^2}f''(u)\\
&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}+\frac{x^2}{y}f''(v)-yv^2f''(v)\\
&=2u f'(u)\\
&=\frac{2y}{x}f'\left(\frac yx\right),
\end{aligned}
$$
其中使用了 $u^2=y^2/x^2$ 与 $yv^2=x^2/y$。

stem: 设函数 $ z = f(x, y) $ 在点 $ (1, 1) $ 处可微，且 $ f(1, 1) = 1 $， $ \left. \frac{\partial f}{\partial x} \right|_{(1,1)} = 2 $， $ \left. \frac{\partial f}{\partial y} \right|_{(1,1)} = 3 $， $ \varphi(x) = f[x, f(x, x)] $。求 $ \left. \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x} \varphi^{3}(x) \right|_{(x=1)} $。
explanation: 第一步：求出 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi(x)}{\mathrm{d}x}\bigg|_{x=1} $。 $ \varphi(x)=f(x,\ f(x,\ x)) $。 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi(x)}{\mathrm{d}x} = f_{1}^{\prime}(x,\ f(x,\ x)) + f_{2}^{\prime}(x, f(x, x))\left[f_{1}^{\prime}(x, x) + f_{2}^{\prime}(x, x)\right] $。 $ \varphi(1) = f(1, f(1, 1)) = f(1, 1) = 1 $。所以 $ \left.\frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi(x)}{\mathrm{d}x}\right|_{x=1} = f_{1}^{\prime}(1, f(1, 1)) + f_{2}^{\prime}(1, f(1, 1)) [f_{1}^{\prime}(1, 1) + f_{2}^{\prime}(1, 1)] = f_{1}^{\prime}(1, 1) + f_{2}^{\prime}(1, 1) [f_{1}^{\prime}(1, 1) + f_{2}^{\prime}(1, 1)] = 2 + 3 \cdot (2 + 3) = 17 $。第二步：求出 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}[\varphi(x)]^{3}}{\mathrm{d}x}\bigg|_{x=1} $。 $ \frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}[\varphi(x)]^{3}=3[\varphi(x)]^{2}\frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi(x)}{\mathrm{d}x} $。代入 x = 1 后，得出： $ \left.\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}x}[\varphi(x)]^{3}\right|_{x=1} =3[\varphi(1)]^{2}\cdot\left.\frac{\mathrm{d}\varphi(x)}{\mathrm{d}x}\right|_{x=1}=3\cdot1\cdot17 =51 $。

stem: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数， $ f(0,1) = 1 $ 是 $ f(u,v) $ 的极值， $ z = f(2x + y, f(x,y)) $。求 $ \left. \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} \right|_{(0,1)} $。
explanation: 对 $ z = f(2x + y, f(x, y)) $ 两端关于 $x$ 求偏导数得 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=2f_{1}^{\prime}(2x+y,f(x,y))+f_{2}^{\prime}(2x+y,f(x,y))\cdot f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)$。继续对上式两端关于 $y$ 求偏导数得 $\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=2f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)+2f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)+\left[f_{21}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)+f_{22}^{\prime \prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\right]f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(2x+y,f(x,y)\right)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}(x,y)$。由极值的必要条件可知 $ f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1)=0 $。将 $ f(0,1)=1,f_{1}^{\prime}(0,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(0,1)=0 $ 代入上式可得 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(0,1)}=2f_{11}^{\prime \prime}\left(1,1\right)+f_{2}^{\prime}\left(1,1\right)f_{12}^{\prime \prime}\left(0,1\right)$.

explanation: 由题，复合函数 $ z = f[xy, f(x, y)] $ 的复合结构图（略）。$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}\left[x y,f(x,y)\right]\cdot y+f_{2}^{\prime}\left[x y,f(x,y)\right]\cdot f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)$。$\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\{f_{11}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot x+f_{12}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\}y+f_{1}^{\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]+\{f_{21}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]x+f_{22}^{\prime\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{2}^{\prime}(x,y)\}f_{1}^{\prime}(x,y)+f_{2}^{\prime}[xy,f(x,y)]\cdot f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x,y)$。由于 $ f(1,1)=1 $ 是极值，故 $ f_{1}^{\prime}(1,1)=f_{2}^{\prime}(1,1)=0 $，于是 $\left.\frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}=f^{\prime \prime}_{11}(1,1)=f^{\prime \prime}_{uu}(1,1)$.

stem:
已知函数 $f(u,v)$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$f(1,1)=2$ 是 $f(u,v)$ 的极值，且
$$
z=f\bigl(x+y,f(x,y)\bigr).
$$
求
$$
\left.\frac{\partial^2z}{\partial x\,\partial y}\right|_{(1,1)}.
$$
explanation:
记外层函数的两个偏导为 $f_1，f_2$。由链式法则，
$$
z_x=f_1\bigl(x+y,f(x,y)\bigr)
+f_2\bigl(x+y,f(x,y)\bigr)f_1(x,y).
$$
再对 $y$ 求偏导，并利用极值的必要条件
$$
f_1(1,1)=f_2(1,1)=0,
$$
在 $(x,y)=(1,1)$ 处仅保留非零项，得到
$$
\left.z_{xy}\right|_{(1,1)}
=f_{11}(2,2)+f_2(2,2)f_{12}(1,1).
$$

stem: 设 $ f, g $ 为连续可微函数， $ u = f(x, xy) $， $ v = g(x + xy) $，求 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} $。
explanation:
$$
 \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial f(x, xy)}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{\mathrm{d}x} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} + y f_{2}^{\prime}. 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = \frac{\partial g(x+xy)}{\partial x} = g^{\prime}(x+xy) \cdot \frac{\partial(x+xy)}{\partial x} = (1+y)g^{\prime}(x+xy). 
$$
 故 $ \frac{\partial u}{\partial x} \cdot \frac{\partial v}{\partial x} = g^{\prime}(x+xy)(1 + y)(f_{1}^{\prime} + yf_{2}^{\prime}) $。

stem: 设 $ z = f\left(xy, \frac{x}{y}\right) + g\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $，其中 $ f, g $ 均可微，则 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = $ ___。
explanation:
本题考查抽象复合函数求偏导，使用链式法则。将 $ y $ 视为常数，对 $ x $ 求偏导： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = y f_{1}^{\prime} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{1}{y} + g^{\prime} \cdot \left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right) = y f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{f_{2}^{\prime}}{y} - \frac{y}{x^{2}} g^{\prime}. 
$$

stem: 设 $ f(u,v) $ 是二元可微函数， $ z = f\left(\frac{y}{x}, \frac{x}{y}\right) $，则 $ x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = $ ___。
explanation:
首先计算偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot \left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}\right) + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{1}{y}, 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot \frac{1}{x} + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right). 
$$
 代入表达式： 
$$
 x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = x\left(-\frac{y}{x^{2}}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y}f_{2}^{\prime}\right) - y\left(\frac{1}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{2}}f_{2}^{\prime}\right) = -\frac{y}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{x}{y}f_{2}^{\prime} - \frac{y}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{x}{y}f_{2}^{\prime} = 2\left(-\frac{y}{x}f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{x}{y}f_{2}^{\prime}\right). 
$$

stem: 已知函数 $ f(u,v) $ 可微， $ z(x,y) = f(x + y, y - x) - f(xy, 2 - x) $，则 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2,2)} - \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(2,2)} = $ ___。
explanation:
根据链式法则： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) - f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) - y f_{1}^{\prime}(xy,2-x) + f_{2}^{\prime}(xy,2-x), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f_{1}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) + f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) - x f_{1}^{\prime}(xy,2-x). 
$$
 于是， 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = -2f_{2}^{\prime}(x+y,y-x) + (x-y)f_{1}^{\prime}(xy,2-x) + f_{2}^{\prime}(xy,2-x). 
$$
 代入点 $ (2,2) $： 
$$
 \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{(2,2)} - \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{(2,2)} = -2f_{2}^{\prime}(4,0) + f_{2}^{\prime}(4,0) = -f_{2}^{\prime}(4,0). 
$$

explanation:
计算偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot y + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot \left(\frac{1}{x} + g^{\prime} \cdot y\right), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = f_{1}^{\prime} \cdot x + f_{2}^{\prime} \cdot g^{\prime} \cdot x. 
$$
 代入表达式： 
$$
 x\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} - y\frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = x\left[y f_{1}^{\prime} + f_{2}^{\prime}\left(\frac{1}{x} + y g^{\prime}\right)\right] - y\left[x f_{1}^{\prime} + x f_{2}^{\prime} g^{\prime}\right] = x y f_{1}^{\prime} + f_{2}^{\prime} + x y f_{2}^{\prime} g^{\prime} - x y f_{1}^{\prime} - x y f_{2}^{\prime} g^{\prime} = f_{2}^{\prime}. 
$$

stem: 设函数 $ f(u, v) $ 具有连续偏导数， $ z = f(xy, x + y) $。若 $ \left. \mathrm{d}z \right|_{x=2, y=3} = 6 \mathrm{d}x + 5 \mathrm{d}y $，则 $ f_{u}^{\prime}(6, 5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6, 5) = $ ___。
explanation:
计算偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = y f_{u}^{\prime}(xy, x+y) + f_{v}^{\prime}(xy, x+y), 
$$
 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} = x f_{u}^{\prime}(xy, x+y) + f_{v}^{\prime}(xy, x+y). 
$$
 由 $ \left.\mathrm{d}z\right|_{x=2, y=3} = 6\mathrm{d}x + 5\mathrm{d}y $，得 $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{x=2, y=3}=6 $， $ \left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{x=2, y=3}=5 $。代入得方程组： 
$$
 \begin{cases} 3f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5) = 6, \\ 2f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5) = 5. \end{cases} 
$$
 解得 $ f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5)=1 $， $ f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5)=3 $。因此， $ f_{u}^{\prime}(6,5) + f_{v}^{\prime}(6,5) = 4 $。

stem: 设 $ z = f(2x - y) + g(x, xy) $，其中函数 $ f(t) $ 二阶可导， $ g(u, v) $ 具有连续二阶偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x \partial y} $。
explanation:
首先计算一阶偏导数： 
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = f^{\prime}(2x - y) \cdot 2 + g_{1}^{\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 1 + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) \cdot y = 2f^{\prime}(2x - y) + g_{1}^{\prime}(x, xy) + y g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy). 
$$
 然后对 $ y $ 求偏导： 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left[2f^{\prime}(2x - y) + g_{1}^{\prime}(x, xy) + y g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy)\right] = 2f^{\prime\prime}(2x - y) \cdot (-1) + \left[g_{11}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 0 + g_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot x\right] + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 1 + y \left[g_{21}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot 0 + g_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) \cdot x\right] = -2f^{\prime\prime}(2x - y) + x g_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) + x y g_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy). 
$$
 由于 $ g $ 具有连续二阶偏导数， $ g_{12}^{\prime\prime} = g_{21}^{\prime\prime} $，最终结果为： 
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y} = -2f^{\prime\prime}(2x - y) + g_{2}^{\prime}(x, xy) + x g_{12}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy) + x y g_{22}^{\prime\prime}(x, xy). 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元复合函数求偏导 / f(u,v) / 常规二阶

stem: 设 $ z = f(2x - y, y \sin x) $，其中 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
answer: $\displaystyle \frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y}=-2\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u^2}+(2\sin x-y\cos x)\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial u\partial v}+y\sin x\cos x\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial v^2}+\cos x\frac{\partial f}{\partial v}$，其中各偏导均在 $(u,v)=(2x-y,y\sin x)$ 处取值。
explanation:
令 $u=2x-y$，$v=y\sin x$，则 $z=f(u,v)$。先对 $x$ 求偏导：
$$
z_x=2f_u+y\cos x\,f_v.
$$
再对 $y$ 求偏导，利用 $u_y=-1$、$v_y=\sin x$ 以及 $f_{uv}=f_{vu}$，得
$$
\frac{\partial^2 z}{\partial x\partial y}=-2f_{uu}+(2\sin x-y\cos x)f_{uv}+y\sin x\cos x\,f_{vv}+\cos x\,f_v.
$$
这里 $f_u,f_v,f_{uu},f_{uv},f_{vv}$ 均表示 $f$ 对相应变量的偏导，并在 $(2x-y,y\sin x)$ 处取值。
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元复合函数求偏导 / f(u,v) / 常规二阶

stem: 设 $ z = f\left(\mathrm{e}^{x} \sin y, x^{2} + y^{2}\right) $，其中 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
answer: $\displaystyle \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\mathrm{e}^{2x}\sin y\cos y\,f_{11}^{\prime\prime}+2\mathrm{e}^{x}(y\sin y+x\cos y)f_{12}^{\prime\prime}+4xyf_{22}^{\prime\prime}+\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y\,f_{1}^{\prime}$，其中各偏导均在 $\left(\mathrm{e}^{x}\sin y,x^{2}+y^{2}\right)$ 处取值。
explanation:
首先，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \mathrm{e}^{x}\sin y \cdot f_{1}^{\prime} + 2x \cdot f_{2}^{\prime} $。
然后，$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) = f_{1}^{\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y + \mathrm{e}^{x}\sin y \left( f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y + 2f_{12}^{\prime\prime}y \right) + 2x \left( f_{21}^{\prime\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y + 2f_{22}^{\prime\prime}y \right) $。
由于 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$ f_{12}^{\prime\prime} = f_{21}^{\prime\prime} $，整理得：$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\mathrm{e}^{2x}\sin y\cos y + 2\mathrm{e}^{x}f_{12}^{\prime\prime}(y\sin y + x\cos y) + 4xyf_{22}^{\prime\prime} + f_{1}^{\prime}\mathrm{e}^{x}\cos y $。
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元复合函数求偏导 / f(u,v) / 常规二阶

stem: 设 $ z = \sin(xy) + \varphi\left(x, \frac{x}{y}\right) $，其中 $ \varphi(u, v) $ 有二阶偏导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2} z}{\partial x \partial y} $。
answer: $\displaystyle \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\cos(xy)-xy\sin(xy)-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\varphi_{uv}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{1}{y^{2}}\varphi_{v}^{\prime}-\frac{x}{y^{3}}\varphi_{vv}^{\prime\prime}$，其中 $\varphi$ 的各偏导均在 $\left(x,\frac{x}{y}\right)$ 处取值。
explanation:
首先，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = y\cos(xy) + \varphi_{u}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y}\varphi_{v}^{\prime} $。
然后，$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) = \cos(xy) - xy\sin(xy) + \left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right)\varphi_{uv}^{\prime\prime} + \left(-\frac{1}{y^{2}}\right)\varphi_{v}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y}\left(-\frac{x}{y^{2}}\right)\varphi_{vv}^{\prime\prime} $。
整理得：$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \cos(xy) - xy\sin(xy) - \frac{x}{y^{2}}\varphi_{uv}^{\prime\prime} - \frac{1}{y^{2}}\varphi_{v}^{\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{3}}\varphi_{vv}^{\prime\prime} $。

stem: 设 $ z = f\left(xy, \frac{x}{y}\right) + g\left(\frac{y}{x}\right) $，其中 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$ g $ 具有二阶连续导数，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
answer: $\displaystyle \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=f_{1}^{\prime}-\frac{1}{y^{2}}f_{2}^{\prime}+xyf_{11}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{x}{y^{3}}f_{22}^{\prime\prime}-\frac{1}{x^{2}}g^{\prime}-\frac{y}{x^{3}}g^{\prime\prime}$，其中 $f$ 的各偏导在 $\left(xy,\frac{x}{y}\right)$ 处取值，$g$ 的导数在 $\frac{y}{x}$ 处取值。
explanation:
首先，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = y f_{1}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y} f_{2}^{\prime} - \frac{y}{x^{2}} g^{\prime} $。
然后，$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}\left(\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right) = f_{1}^{\prime} + y\left( x f_{11}^{\prime\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{2}} f_{12}^{\prime\prime} \right) - \frac{1}{y^{2}} f_{2}^{\prime} + \frac{1}{y}\left( x f_{21}^{\prime\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{2}} f_{22}^{\prime\prime} \right) - \frac{1}{x^{2}} g^{\prime} - \frac{y}{x^{2}} g^{\prime\prime} \cdot \frac{1}{x} $。
由于 $ f $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$ f_{12}^{\prime\prime} = f_{21}^{\prime\prime} $，整理得：$ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = f_{1}^{\prime} - \frac{1}{y^{2}} f_{2}^{\prime} + x y f_{11}^{\prime\prime} - \frac{x}{y^{3}} f_{22}^{\prime\prime} - \frac{1}{x^{2}} g^{\prime} - \frac{y}{x^{3}} g^{\prime\prime} $。

stem: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，$ z = f(x, xy) $，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
explanation:
**第一步：求对 $x$ 的一阶偏导数**

由链式法则：
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f^{\prime}_1 + f^{\prime}_2 \cdot \frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial x}=f^{\prime}_1 + f^{\prime}_2 \cdot y. 
$$

**第二步：求对 $y$ 的二阶偏导数**

对 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}$ 再对 $y$ 求偏导：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(f^{\prime}_1) + \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(y f^{\prime}_2). 
$$
计算各项：
$$
 \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(f^{\prime}_1) = f_{12}^{\prime\prime} \cdot \frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial y} = f_{12}^{\prime\prime} \cdot x. 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(y f^{\prime}_2) = f^{\prime}_2 + y \cdot \frac{\partial}{\partial y}(f^{\prime}_2) = f^{\prime}_2 + y \cdot (f_{22}^{\prime\prime} \cdot \frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial y}) = f^{\prime}_2 + xy f_{22}^{\prime\prime}. 
$$
合并得：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} = f_{12}^{\prime\prime} \cdot x + f^{\prime}_2 + xy f_{22}^{\prime\prime} = (f_{12}^{\prime\prime} + y f_{22}^{\prime\prime})x + f^{\prime}_2. 
$$
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元复合函数求偏导 / f(u,v) / 常规二阶

stem: 设 $ z = f(x + y, x - y, xy) $，其中 $f$ 具有二阶连续偏导数，求 $dz$ 与 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $。
answer: $\displaystyle \mathrm{d}z=(f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}+yf_{3}^{\prime})\mathrm{d}x+(f_{1}^{\prime}-f_{2}^{\prime}+xf_{3}^{\prime})\mathrm{d}y$；$\displaystyle \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=f_{11}^{\prime\prime}+f_{3}^{\prime}+(x+y)f_{13}^{\prime\prime}-f_{22}^{\prime\prime}+(x-y)f_{23}^{\prime\prime}+xyf_{33}^{\prime\prime}$。各偏导均在 $(x+y,x-y,xy)$ 处取值。
explanation:
记中间变量：$ u_1 = x + y $，$ u_2 = x - y $，$ u_3 = xy $。

**第一步：求一阶偏导数 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x} $，$ \frac{\partial z}{\partial y} $ 和 $dz$**

由链式法则：
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(x+y)}{\partial x}+f_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(x-y)}{\partial x}+f_{3}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}\cdot1+f_{2}^{\prime}\cdot1+yf_{3}^{\prime}=f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}+yf_{3}^{\prime}. 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=f_{1}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(x+y)}{\partial y}+f_{2}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(x-y)}{\partial y}+f_{3}^{\prime}\frac{\partial(xy)}{\partial y}=f_{1}^{\prime}\cdot1-f_{2}^{\prime}\cdot1+xf_{3}^{\prime}=f_{1}^{\prime}-f_{2}^{\prime}+xf_{3}^{\prime}. 
$$
则全微分为：
$$
 dz=\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}dx+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}dy=(f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}+yf_{3}^{\prime})dx+(f_{1}^{\prime}-f_{2}^{\prime}+xf_{3}^{\prime})dy. 
$$

**第二步：求二阶偏导数 $ \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} $**

由 $ \frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=f_{1}^{\prime}+f_{2}^{\prime}+yf_{3}^{\prime} $，对 $y$ 求偏导：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y}=\frac{\partial f_{1}^{\prime}}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial f_{2}^{\prime}}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial(y f_{3}^{\prime})}{\partial y}. 
$$
分别计算（注意 $f$ 二阶偏导连续，故混合偏导相等）：
$$
 \frac{\partial f_{1}^{\prime}}{\partial y}=f_{11}^{\prime\prime}\cdot1+f_{12}^{\prime\prime}\cdot(-1)+f_{13}^{\prime\prime}\cdot x = f_{11}^{\prime\prime} - f_{12}^{\prime\prime} + x f_{13}^{\prime\prime}. 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial f_{2}^{\prime}}{\partial y}=f_{21}^{\prime\prime}\cdot1+f_{22}^{\prime\prime}\cdot(-1)+f_{23}^{\prime\prime}\cdot x = f_{21}^{\prime\prime} - f_{22}^{\prime\prime} + x f_{23}^{\prime\prime}. 
$$
$$
 \frac{\partial(y f_{3}^{\prime})}{\partial y}=f_{3}^{\prime} + y \cdot \frac{\partial f_{3}^{\prime}}{\partial y} = f_{3}^{\prime} + y(f_{31}^{\prime\prime}\cdot1+f_{32}^{\prime\prime}\cdot(-1)+f_{33}^{\prime\prime}\cdot x) = f_{3}^{\prime} + y f_{31}^{\prime\prime} - y f_{32}^{\prime\prime} + xy f_{33}^{\prime\prime}. 
$$
合并，并利用 $f_{12}^{\prime\prime}=f_{21}^{\prime\prime}$，$f_{13}^{\prime\prime}=f_{31}^{\prime\prime}$，$f_{23}^{\prime\prime}=f_{32}^{\prime\prime}$ 进行化简：
$$
 \begin{aligned} \frac{\partial^{2}z}{\partial x\partial y} &= (f_{11}^{\prime\prime} - f_{12}^{\prime\prime} + x f_{13}^{\prime\prime}) + (f_{21}^{\prime\prime} - f_{22}^{\prime\prime} + x f_{23}^{\prime\prime}) + (f_{3}^{\prime} + y f_{31}^{\prime\prime} - y f_{32}^{\prime\prime} + xy f_{33}^{\prime\prime}) \\ &= f_{11}^{\prime\prime} + f_{3}^{\prime} + (x+y)f_{13}^{\prime\prime} - f_{22}^{\prime\prime} + (x-y)f_{23}^{\prime\prime} + xy f_{33}^{\prime\prime}. \end{aligned} 
$$

stem: 设 $ f(u,v) $ 具有二阶连续偏导数，且满足 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} = 1 $，又 $ g(x,y) = f\left[ xy, \frac{1}{2}(x^{2} - y^{2}) \right] $，求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $。
explanation: 令 $ u = xy, v = \frac{1}{2}(x^{2} - y^{2}) $。先求一阶偏导：$ \frac{\partial g}{\partial x} = y \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} + x \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} $，$ \frac{\partial g}{\partial y} = x \frac{\partial f}{\partial u} - y \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} $。再求二阶偏导：$ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}} = y^{2} \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}} + 2xy \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u \partial v} + x^{2} \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} + \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} $，$ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} = x^{2} \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}} - 2xy \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u \partial v} + y^{2} \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} - \frac{\partial f}{\partial v} $。两式相加得：$ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} = (x^{2}+y^{2}) \left( \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} \right) $。代入条件 $ \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial u^{2}} + \frac{\partial^{2}f}{\partial v^{2}} = 1 $，得结果为 $ x^{2} + y^{2} $。
category_path: 高等数学 / 多元微分 / 偏导数 / 多元复合函数求偏导 / f(u,v) / 常规二阶

stem: 设函数 $ f(u,v) $ 具有 2 阶连续偏导数，函数 $ g(x,y)=xy-f(x+y,x-y) $。求 $ \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}} $
explanation:
令 $ u=x+y, v=x-y $，则 $ g(x,y)=xy-f(u,v) $。

$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial x}=y-(f'_u+f'_v) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}=-(f''_{uu}+2f''_{uv}+f''_{vv}) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}=1-(f''_{uu}-f''_{vv}) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial g}{\partial y}=x-(f'_u-f'_v) 
$$

$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=-(f''_{uu}-2f''_{uv}+f''_{vv}) 
$$

将以上三式相加得：
$$
 \frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x^{2}}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial x\partial y}+\frac{\partial^{2}g}{\partial y^{2}}=1-3f''_{uu}-f''_{vv} 
$$
